dead-letter:q.title: Failed messages are dropped
dead-letter:q.message: Worker fails 100% of messages, and orders has no dead-letter queue: messages that run out of deliveries (1) are lost.
dead-letter:q.rationale: A message that keeps failing is redelivered up to the broker's delivery limit, then goes to the broker's dead-letter route, or is dropped when there isn't one (or its filter doesn't take the message). A dead-letter queue keeps it to inspect and replay.
